message: In the under-deck vertical Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) at midspan (C1), Manager, the first vertical bending mode placement and tuning has needed confirmation that midspan maximises modal coupling without altering deck sightlines. To check it I used modal layout and optimal tuning review (the side-view mode-shape layout (E3) and the optimal Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) sizing (E4)). I found 1.9 Hertz (Hz) bridge mode with 1.86 Hz Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) frequency at 400 kilograms and 0.086 Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) damping ratio hidden below soffit, according to Den Hartog, 1934. I propose retaining two 200 kilogram modules on under-deck cross-frames at midspan. My position: not ready because joint proposal is pending. In the bare and retrofitted 40 metre footbridge dynamics, Vibration Control Specialist and Pedestrian Comfort and Construction Planner, the low-damping baseline versus controlled comfort has needed closure against limits. To check it I used resonant and controlled-response comparison (the resonant response calculation (E1), the controlled-response stroke estimate (E6) and the detuned damping estimate (E8)). I found about 1.75 metres per second squared baseline at 0.4 percent damping falling to about 0.20 metres per second squared with effective damping of 0.064 even at plus 5 percent detune, according to Human Induced Vibrations of Steel Structures (HIVOSS), 2008. I propose holding Comfort Class 1 target below 0.5 metres per second squared. My position: not ready because Retrofit Integration Architect girder fatigue review must join the proposal.
